effect.u_message:
Mikhail, if you reach the camp first: we moved the wounded to the southwest tent. The creature came out of the northern tent and caught Pavel in the open. Keep behind the tent walls and leave through the gap in the eastern fence. We are leaving before dusk.

Lena.

effect.u_message:
The last prayer is crossed out.

We barred the main doors to keep strangers out. Now footsteps sound inside. Irina carried the remaining blankets through the vestry; I couldn't persuade her to return for the stone. The western wall is breached. Follow the living while there is still time.

//: Reference journal: physical source only; rereading never reapplies progression.

effect.u_message:
The eastern passage is wide enough to carry him, but the scratches there are fresh. I left the iron crowbar by the broken support. We circled the stone pendant and approached the prop from below. The peg can be pulled out from that side.

If he wakes, first we'll try to reach the stairs, not the red face.

effect.u_message: The wrapping carries the same two-knotted cord as the ward farther up the path. Only one set of bones remains here. A shallow groove in the soil leads toward the abandoned camp, then disappears beneath new roots.
